blocks.x: AI your model-risk committee approves and your regulator can inspect.

Driisti Smart Vision Glasses operationalizes AI governance: the policy layer (NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, EU AI Act mapping), model registry with technical documentation, evaluation harnesses with red-team suites, guardrail configuration, incident response for AI events, and the evidence pack that turns conformity assessment into a formality.

Compass is where AI programs stop being risky: every model carries its model card, its evaluation results, its guardrail configuration and its control owner. High-risk use cases (credit scoring, employment, medical) get the documentation, human-oversight and post-market monitoring the EU AI Act actually requires — built in, not bolted on.

items: regime mapping to controls and owners
golden datasets, judge panels, red teams
PII, injection, topic fences as code

blocks.x: Compass treats governance as system behavior: policies versioned, evaluations gated in CI, incidents tracked to closure with owners. The output is an AI estate your CISO defends to the board and your regulator inspects without expeditions.

items: every artifact the platform produces doubles as audit evidence — no reconstruction projects.
teams start at pattern 80% and spend their budget on the 20% that is genuinely yours.
named control owner per deployment; platform telemetry makes the owner's job inspectable.

blocks.x: Driisti Smart Vision Glasses typically enters an estate during the Prove phase — configured for your controls in the sandbox, hardened through Industrialize, and left running under the customer's own keys with our pods on the follow-the-sun operations rhythm.
Certified integration surface: MLflow, evaluation frameworks, guardrail libraries, GRC integration.
Primary industry deployments: Banking & Financial Services, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Insurance & Risk, Public Sector & Government, Technology & SaaS, Education & Research.
